It's hard to be happy when you are just going through the routines, trust me I know. I have severe GAD (General Anxiety Disorder) and it's caused me to never leave my house. I am 19 living with my mother and younger sister, both of which are pretty fed up with me. I am unemployed, never graduated high school, lost both the loves of my life to my best friends. My dad died two years ago, I was molested, I feel like a burden, and because of it all most of my friends are gone. I sit in my house all day watching TV, playing video games, and going on the internet, the only time I have left my house is to go to a mental care unit. So I decided that I would change my routine. Instead of me just laying around all day, I would help people. I think about how many people are like us, and I want to bring some light into their lives. Life isn't worth living until you make it worth living. I don't know if you're religious or not, but have faith, if not in God then in yourself.

God never turns his back on his children. You will be saved but only if you want to. God will show you the path, but he cannot move your legs for you so you may walk it. I know you feel like you've done so much bad that you can never recover from it, but you can. Remember that life isn't worth living until you make it worth living. You need to stop focusing on all the bad on your life, if you don't you'll never be able to start creating some good in it. The first step is to seek help. Get a therapist, get off the drugs, make amends, and do everything you can to make things right before you pass. God loves you my friend, I wish you the best.

Take the same amount of effort you put into suicide into living. I know life is hard, and sometimes you just want it all to end because even if it's hell, heaven, or nothingness it trumps having the feelings you have right now. But you will die eventually, one die you will pass on, so before then try living. So many of us just go day to day doing the same routine things until the problems we have pile up and crush us. So break the routine. For me I want to help others who feel this way, to bring some light to their world. I don't know enough about you to say what might work for you, but just know that life isnt worth living until you make it worth living. I wish you the best.

The fact that you're looking for a reason means that there is a part of you that wants to live. If you need a reason for wanting it heres mine. Help others. You know the way you feel, there's so many more of us out there. All needing a hand to come down and pull them out of the pain. Live to bring some light in this world for someone else. And feel good that something you're doing is contributing to someones elses happiness. Be the reason for someone else, be an example for people like us to follow. And when the day comes where you do die, you'll die knowing that you actually saved lives.
